title: Sign in
subtitle: We will email you a sign-in link. No password needed.
sent: Check your email. Open the link on this phone to sign in.
failed: We could not send the link. Wait a minute and try again.
linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
noAccessBody: You are signed in as {email}, but this account has not been added to Beehive Home yet. Ask the owner to add you in Settings › People.
